name: quantecon-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is QuantEcon.py, a Python library for quantitative economics. It provides
finite-state Markov chains (stationary distributions, communication and recurrent classes, periods, simulation,
estimation and the Tauchen and Rouwenhorst discretizations), discrete dynamic programs (`DiscreteDP` with value,
policy and modified policy iteration, linear programming and backward induction), normal-form games and their
Nash equilibrium solvers and learning dynamics, linear programming, complementarity, root finding and scalar
maximization routines, quadrature rules, linear-quadratic control and Kalman filtering, matrix equations, and
random-sampling, grid and inequality utilities.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the following, and nothing else: quantecon/__init__.py, the underscore-prefixed implementation modules directly under quantecon/ (quantecon/_arma.py through quantecon/_robustlq.py), quantecon/distributions.py, quantecon/quad.py, and every module of the quantecon/markov, quantecon/game_theory, quantecon/optimize and quantecon/random packages (their tests directories excluded), together with README.md and the docstrings of those modules (module, class, function and method docstrings, including their doctest examples).

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says,
